headline: President Clinton changed an earlier order that set up the federal effort to prepare computer systems for the year 2000 date change.
what_it_does: This order amends Executive Order 13073, which created the government's effort to deal with the "Year 2000" (Y2K) computer problem. That problem came from older computers that stored years with only two digits and might fail when the date changed to 2000. The title does not say what specific changes this amendment made.

who_it_affects.how: They were the main subject of the original Y2K order, so changes to it would shape how they handled the date change.

when_it_takes_effect: Likely upon signing on June 14, 1999, though the source does not say.
